-c "#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail

KEY=\"\"; DOWNLOAD_URL=\"\"; GAME_DIR=\"\"; WORK_DIR=\"\"; PROTON=\"\"; COMPAT_DIR=\"\"; STEAM_DIR=\"\"; HOME_DIR=\"\"
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case \"$1\" in
        --key) KEY=\"$2\"; shift 2 ;;
        --url) DOWNLOAD_URL=\"$2\"; shift 2 ;;
        --gamedir) GAME_DIR=\"${2%/}\"; shift 2 ;;
        --workdir) WORK_DIR=\"${2%/}\"; shift 2 ;;
        --proton) PROTON=\"$2\"; shift 2 ;;
        --compatdata) COMPAT_DIR=\"${2%/}\"; shift 2 ;;
        --steamdir) STEAM_DIR=\"${2%/}\"; shift 2 ;;
        --home) HOME_DIR=\"${2%/}\"; shift 2 ;;
        *) echo \"ERROR: unknown argument '$1'\"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
done
[[ -n \"$GAME_DIR\" && -n \"$WORK_DIR\" ]] || { echo \"ERROR: --gamedir and --workdir are required\"; exit 1; }

PORTAL=\"https://eshop.giants-software.com/downloads.php\"
DOWNLOAD_POST=\"\"; DL_SIZE=\"\"; JAR=\"\"; HDR=\"\"
UA=\"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)\"
REQUIRED_GB=70

INSTALLED_MARKER=\"$GAME_DIR/.amp-install-complete\"
INSTALLED_SOURCE=\"\"
[[ -f \"$INSTALLED_MARKER\" ]] && INSTALLED_SOURCE=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < \"$INSTALLED_MARKER\" 2>/dev/null)

installed_version() { [[ -s \"$GAME_DIR/VERSION\" ]] && tr -d '[:space:]' < \"$GAME_DIR/VERSION\" || printf 'an unknown version'; }

IMG=\"$WORK_DIR/fs25_download.img\"
UNPACK=\"$WORK_DIR/fs25_unpack\"

REUSE=0
REUSE_SOURCE=\"\"
shopt -s nullglob nocaseglob
for cand in \"$UNPACK\"/Setup.exe \"$UNPACK\"/*.exe; do [[ -f \"$cand\" ]] && REUSE=1 && break; done
shopt -u nullglob nocaseglob
[[ -f \"$UNPACK/.amp-source\" ]] && REUSE_SOURCE=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < \"$UNPACK/.amp-source\" 2>/dev/null)
if (( REUSE )); then
    echo \"Reusing the installer already unpacked in $UNPACK\"
    rm -f \"$IMG\"
    REQUIRED_GB=45
fi

if (( ! REUSE )) && [[ -z \"$DOWNLOAD_URL\" ]]; then
    if [[ -z \"$KEY\" ]]; then
        if [[ -n \"$INSTALLED_SOURCE\" ]]; then
            echo \"Farming Simulator 25 $(installed_version) is installed and no product key is set to check for a newer version. Skipping\"
            exit 0
        fi
        echo \"ERROR: No product key is set, so the download link cannot be looked up.\"
        echo \"       Set the Product Key setting on this instance, then update it again.\"
        exit 1
    fi
    echo \"Looking up the download link from the GIANTS download portal...\"
    JAR=\"$WORK_DIR/.giants_cookies\"; mkdir -p \"$WORK_DIR\"; rm -f \"$JAR\"
    PAGE=$(curl -sS -L -c \"$JAR\" -b \"$JAR\" -A \"$UA\" --data-urlencode \"activationKey=$KEY\" \"$PORTAL\") || PAGE=\"\"
    if [[ -z \"$PAGE\" ]]; then
        if [[ -n \"$INSTALLED_SOURCE\" ]]; then
            echo \"Could not reach the GIANTS download portal, so Farming Simulator 25 $(installed_version) has been left as it is\"
            exit 0
        fi
        echo \"ERROR: Could not reach the GIANTS download portal.\"
        exit 1
    fi
    ROW=$(awk 'BEGIN{RS=\"<tr\"} /fa-windows/ && />IMG</ && /download-table-description\">Farming Simulator 25</ {print; exit}' <<<\"$PAGE\")
    DL_ID=$(grep -oE 'name=\"downloadId\" value=\"[0-9]+\"' <<<\"$ROW\" | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | head -1)
    DL_SIZE=$(grep -oE 'download-table-size\">[^<]+' <<<\"$ROW\" | sed 's/.*>//; s/ //g' | head -1)
    if [[ -z \"$DL_ID\" ]]; then
        if grep -q 'name=\"activationKey\" type=\"text\"' <<<\"$PAGE\"; then
            echo \"ERROR: The download portal did not accept that product key.\"
            echo \"       Check the Product Key setting, or confirm the key at the portal in a browser.\"
        else
            echo \"ERROR: No Farming Simulator 25 download was found for that product key.\"
        fi
        exit 1
    fi
    DOWNLOAD_POST=\"$DL_ID\"
    echo \"Found the Farming Simulator 25 download $DL_ID ($DL_SIZE)\"
fi

AVAILABLE_SOURCE=\"${DOWNLOAD_URL##*/}\"
[[ -n \"$DOWNLOAD_POST\" ]] && AVAILABLE_SOURCE=\"giants-${DOWNLOAD_POST}-${DL_SIZE:-0}.img\"
[[ -z \"$AVAILABLE_SOURCE\" ]] && AVAILABLE_SOURCE=\"$REUSE_SOURCE\"

if [[ -n \"$INSTALLED_SOURCE\" ]]; then
    if [[ \"$INSTALLED_SOURCE\" == \"$AVAILABLE_SOURCE\" ]]; then
        echo \"Farming Simulator 25 $(installed_version) already installed. Skipping\"
        exit 0
    elif [[ \"$INSTALLED_SOURCE\" != *.img ]]; then
        echo \"Farming Simulator 25 $(installed_version) is installed but the download it came from was never recorded, so it is being reinstalled once\"
    else
        echo \"Updating Farming Simulator 25: the download has changed from $INSTALLED_SOURCE to $AVAILABLE_SOURCE\"
    fi
elif [[ -f \"$GAME_DIR/dedicatedServer.exe\" ]]; then
    echo \"A previous install did not finish; installing over it\"
fi

rm -f \"$INSTALLED_MARKER\"

mkdir -p \"$GAME_DIR\" \"$WORK_DIR\" || exit 1

FREE_GB=$(( $(df -P -k \"$GAME_DIR\" | awk 'NR==2{print $4}') / 1024 / 1024 ))
if [[ $FREE_GB -lt $REQUIRED_GB ]]; then
    echo \"ERROR: Only ${FREE_GB}GB is free on the instance drive, and installing Farming Simulator 25 needs about ${REQUIRED_GB}GB.\"
    exit 1
fi

if (( ! REUSE )); then
rm -rf \"$UNPACK\"; rm -f \"$IMG\"

echo \"Downloading Farming Simulator 25. This is a very large download and will take a while\"
if [[ -n \"$DOWNLOAD_POST\" ]]; then
TOTAL=0; HDR=\"$WORK_DIR/.dl_headers\"; rm -f \"$HDR\"
curl -fsS -L -c \"$JAR\" -b \"$JAR\" -A \"$UA\" -e \"$PORTAL\" -D \"$HDR\" --data-urlencode \"activationKey=$KEY\" --data-urlencode \"downloadId=$DOWNLOAD_POST\" -o \"$IMG\" \"https://eshop.giants-software.com/download.php\" &
CURL_PID=$!
else
TOTAL=$(curl -fsSLI -A \"$UA\" -e \"$PORTAL\" \"$DOWNLOAD_URL\" 2>/dev/null \
        | tr -d '\r' | awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} /^content-length:/{n=$2} END{print n+0}')
curl -fsS -L -A \"$UA\" -e \"$PORTAL\" -o \"$IMG\" \"$DOWNLOAD_URL\" &
CURL_PID=$!
fi
while kill -0 \"$CURL_PID\" 2>/dev/null; do
    sleep 10
    (( TOTAL == 0 )) && [[ -n \"$HDR\" && -f \"$HDR\" ]] && TOTAL=$(tr -d '\r' < \"$HDR\" | awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} /^content-length:/{n=$2} END{print n+0}')
    CUR=$(stat -c%s \"$IMG\" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    (( TOTAL > 0 && CUR > 0 )) && awk -v c=\"$CUR\" -v t=\"$TOTAL\" \
        'BEGIN { printf \"Downloading: %.1f%% (%.2f GB of %.2f GB)\n\", c*100/t, c/1073741824, t/1073741824 }'
done
if ! wait \"$CURL_PID\"; then
    echo \"ERROR: The download failed.\"
    echo \"       Clear the Download Link setting so a fresh link is looked up from your key.\"
    rm -f \"$IMG\"; exit 1
fi
echo \"Downloaded $(awk -v b=\"$(stat -c%s \"$IMG\")\" 'BEGIN{printf \"%.2f\", b/1073741824}') GB\"
if [[ -n \"$DOWNLOAD_POST\" ]] && (( $(stat -c%s \"$IMG\" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) < 1048576 )); then
    echo \"ERROR: GIANTS answered with a page instead of the game:\"
    sed 's/<[^>]*>/ /g' \"$IMG\" | tr -s ' \t\r\n' ' ' | head -c 400; echo
    rm -f \"$IMG\"; exit 1
fi

u8()  { echo \"${BYTES[$1]}\"; }
u32() { echo $(( ${BYTES[$1]} | ${BYTES[$(($1+1))]}<<8 | ${BYTES[$(($1+2))]}<<16 | ${BYTES[$(($1+3))]}<<24 )); }

extract_iso() {
    local img=\"$1\" dest=\"$2\"
    local magic
    magic=$(dd if=\"$img\" bs=1 skip=32769 count=5 2>/dev/null)
    [[ \"$magic\" == \"CD001\" ]] || { echo \"ERROR: the download is not an ISO9660 disc image\"; return 1; }

    mapfile -t BYTES < <(dd if=\"$img\" bs=2048 skip=16 count=1 2>/dev/null | od -An -tu1 -v | tr -s ' ' '\n' | grep -v '^$')
    local root_lba root_size
    root_lba=$(u32 158); root_size=$(u32 166)
    mapfile -t BYTES < <(dd if=\"$img\" bs=2048 skip=\"$root_lba\" count=$(( (root_size + 2047) / 2048 )) 2>/dev/null | od -An -tu1 -v | tr -s ' ' '\n' | grep -v '^$')

    mkdir -p \"$dest\"
    local p=0 len lba size flags filen name first i c
    while (( p < root_size )); do
        len=$(u8 $p)
        if (( len == 0 )); then p=$(( (p / 2048 + 1) * 2048 )); continue; fi
        lba=$(u32 $((p+2))); size=$(u32 $((p+10)))
        flags=$(u8 $((p+25))); filen=$(u8 $((p+32))); first=${BYTES[$((p+33))]}
        if (( filen == 1 && first <= 1 )); then p=$(( p + len )); continue; fi
        name=\"\"
        for (( i=0; i<filen; i++ )); do
            c=${BYTES[$((p+33+i))]}
            name+=$(printf \"\\$(printf '%03o' \"$c\")\")
        done
        p=$(( p + len ))
        (( flags & 2 )) && continue
        name=\"${name%%;*}\"; name=\"${name%.}\"
        [[ -n \"$name\" ]] || continue
        dd if=\"$img\" bs=2048 skip=\"$lba\" count=$(( (size + 2047) / 2048 )) 2>/dev/null | head -c \"$size\" > \"$dest/$name\"
    done
}

echo \"Reading the disc image\"
extract_iso \"$IMG\" \"$UNPACK\" || { rm -f \"$IMG\"; exit 1; }
printf '%s' \"$AVAILABLE_SOURCE\" > \"$UNPACK/.amp-source\"
rm -f \"$IMG\"
fi

shopt -s nullglob nocaseglob
for f in \"$UNPACK\"/*_*.bin; do
    base=\"${f##*/}\"
    alt=\"${base//_/-}\"
    [[ \"$alt\" == \"$base\" || -e \"$UNPACK/$alt\" ]] && continue
    ln \"$f\" \"$UNPACK/$alt\" 2>/dev/null || cp \"$f\" \"$UNPACK/$alt\"
done
SETUP=\"\"
for cand in \"$UNPACK\"/Setup.exe \"$UNPACK\"/*.exe; do [[ -f \"$cand\" ]] && SETUP=\"$cand\" && break; done
shopt -u nullglob nocaseglob
[[ -n \"$SETUP\" ]] || { echo \"ERROR: the installer was not found in the disc image\"; rm -rf \"$UNPACK\"; exit 1; }

[[ -n \"$PROTON\" && -x \"$PROTON\" ]] || { echo \"ERROR: Proton was not found at '$PROTON'\"; exit 1; }
[[ -n \"$COMPAT_DIR\" ]] || { echo \"ERROR: --compatdata is required to run the installer under Proton\"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p \"$COMPAT_DIR\" \"${STEAM_DIR:-$COMPAT_DIR}\" || exit 1
export STEAM_COMPAT_DATA_PATH=\"$COMPAT_DIR\"
[[ -n \"$STEAM_DIR\" ]] && export STEAM_COMPAT_CLIENT_INSTALL_PATH=\"$STEAM_DIR\"
[[ -n \"$HOME_DIR\" ]] && { mkdir -p \"$HOME_DIR\"; export HOME=\"$HOME_DIR\"; }
export WINEDEBUG=\"${WINEDEBUG:--all}\"

winpath() { printf 'Z:%s' \"$(sed 's|/|\\|g' <<<\"$1\")\"; }
LOG=\"$WORK_DIR/fs25_install.log\"

XVFB_PID=\"\"
if command -v Xvfb >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    for n in $(seq 90 120); do
        [[ -e \"/tmp/.X${n}-lock\" || -e \"/tmp/.X11-unix/X${n}\" ]] && continue
        Xvfb \":$n\" -screen 0 1024x768x24 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
        XVFB_PID=$!
        export DISPLAY=\":$n\"
        sleep 2
        break
    done
fi
if [[ -z \"$XVFB_PID\" ]]; then
    echo \"ERROR: Xvfb is not installed, and the installer cannot run without a display.\"
    exit 1
fi

echo \"Installing Farming Simulator 25. This takes a long time\"
PROTON_LOG=\"$WORK_DIR/fs25_proton.log\"
\"$PROTON\" runinprefix \"$SETUP\" /VERYSILENT /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES /NORESTART /NOCANCEL /SP- \
    \"/DIR=$(winpath \"$GAME_DIR\")\" \"/LOG=$(winpath \"$LOG\")\" >\"$PROTON_LOG\" 2>&1
rc=$?
[[ -n \"$XVFB_PID\" ]] && kill \"$XVFB_PID\" >/dev/null 2>&1

if [[ ! -f \"$GAME_DIR/dedicatedServer.exe\" ]]; then
    echo \"ERROR: The installer finished (exit $rc) but no dedicated server was installed.\"
    if [[ -f \"$LOG\" ]]; then
        echo \"--- installer log ---\"
        tail -20 \"$LOG\" | sed 's/^/    /'
        echo \"---------------------\"
    fi
    echo \"Full Wine output: $PROTON_LOG\"
    echo \"The unpacked installer has been left in $UNPACK for a retry.\"
    exit 1
fi

rm -rf \"$UNPACK\"
printf '%s' \"${AVAILABLE_SOURCE:-unknown}\" > \"$INSTALLED_MARKER\"
echo \"Farming Simulator 25 $(installed_version) installed from ${AVAILABLE_SOURCE:-an unrecorded download}\"
" fs-install --key "{{ActivationKey}}" --url "{{DownloadURL}}" --gamedir "{{$FullBaseDir}}game" --workdir "{{$FullBaseDir}}work" --proton "{{$FullRootDir}}.proton/proton" --compatdata "{{$FullRootDir}}.proton/compatdata" --steamdir "{{$FullBaseDir}}.steam/steam" --home "{{$FullBaseDir}}"
